concepts.name: Driver
concepts.definition: A Formula 1 driver identified by driverId, with full name from forename and surname, and code as the abbreviated code.

concepts.name: DriverNationality
concepts.definition: The nationality attribute of a driver.

concepts.name: DriverDateOfBirth
concepts.definition: The date of birth of a driver, used to compute age or birth year.

concepts.name: Constructor
concepts.definition: A Formula 1 constructor/team identified by constructorId, with reference name and nationality.

concepts.name: ConstructorNationality
concepts.definition: The nationality attribute of a constructor.

concepts.name: Race
concepts.definition: A Formula 1 race event identified by raceId, with name, year, round, date and circuit.

concepts.name: RaceName
concepts.definition: The official name of a race event.

concepts.name: RaceYear
concepts.definition: The season year in which a race took place.

concepts.name: RaceDate
concepts.definition: The calendar date on which a race took place.

concepts.name: Circuit
concepts.definition: A racing circuit identified by circuitId, with name, location, country and coordinates.

concepts.name: CircuitCountry
concepts.definition: The country in which a circuit is located.

concepts.name: CircuitCoordinates
concepts.definition: The latitude and longitude coordinates of a circuit.

concepts.name: RaceResult
concepts.definition: A driver's result in a race, including finishing position, points, laps and time.

concepts.name: RaceCompletion
concepts.definition: Whether a driver completed a race, indicated by a non-null time value in results.

concepts.name: Points
concepts.definition: The championship points scored by a driver or constructor in a race or standings.

concepts.name: Wins
concepts.definition: The number of race wins recorded for a driver or constructor.

concepts.name: FastestLap
concepts.definition: The fastest lap achieved by a driver in a race, recorded as lap number and time.

concepts.name: LapTime
concepts.definition: The time taken to complete a lap, recorded in milliseconds.

concepts.name: LapNumber
concepts.definition: The sequential number of a lap within a race.

concepts.name: Qualifying
concepts.definition: A driver's qualifying performance in a race, with Q1, Q2 and Q3 times and position.

concepts.name: PitStop
concepts.definition: A pit stop made by a driver during a race, with stop number and duration.

concepts.name: Status
concepts.definition: The finishing status of a driver in a race.

caveats.statement: Some drivers have NULL code values, so queries relying on driver code may miss them.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE code IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some races have NULL time values, which may affect time-based calculations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE time IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some results have NULL time values, indicating non-finishers, which affects completion rate calculations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE time IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some qualifying sessions have NULL q3 times, which may affect fastest qualifying queries.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying WHERE q3 IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some drivers have NULL date of birth, which may affect age-based calculations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NULL;

derived.name: DriverAge
